result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured scope aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the export. It compiles (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`), but I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It replaces the five fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals with a loop over the main, test, generated, build-and-deploy and other aspects. For each one it builds the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same method that writes the loose text files. It reads that file and uses the same name for the zip entry.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The missing-file exception no longer aborts `exportZips()`, so `git-history.zip` is written as well when `git-history.txt` exists.

I also added the `NamedSourceCodeAspect` import.
